# Japan municipality boundaries

Source: [SmartNews Media Research Institute Japan Topography](https://github.com/smartnews-smri/japan-topography), pinned commit `b403e71eb97f1fdf32f63d16bd485129f703855e`.

Underlying government data: [MLIT National Land Numerical Information — Administrative Areas, N03, 1 January 2021](https://nlftp.mlit.go.jp/ksj/gml/datalist/KsjTmplt-N03-v3_0.html).

The publisher allows free commercial and noncommercial use and asks users to follow the underlying MLIT credit requirements. Current [MLIT terms](https://nlftp.mlit.go.jp/ksj/other/agreement.html) apply Public Data License 1.0 to content without a separate notice, require attribution, and require stating when content has been edited. The N03 dataset is identified as open data for 2018 and later editions.

Suggested credit, including the modification notice:

> 国土数値情報（行政区域データ、2021年）（国土交通省）をもとに加工。SmartNews Media Research Institute simplified boundaries.

The retained SOURCE-README.md is the publisher's original documentation, including its data sourcing and usage statement. metadata.json pins source URLs and SHA-256 hashes and documents normalization and territorial coverage. This is a local personal map dataset, not a statement about territorial claims.
